import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from brackets.core import is_balanced, is_bracket, PAIRS, OPEN, CLOSE

# Helper to assert
def assert_eq(actual, expected, msg):
    if actual != expected:
        raise AssertionError(f'{msg}: got {actual}, expected {expected}')

# Test empty string
assert_eq(is_balanced(''), True, "empty string")
# Simple pairs
assert_eq(is_balanced('()'), True, "()")
assert_eq(is_balanced('[]'), True, "[]")
assert_eq(is_balanced('{}'), True, "{}")
assert_eq(is_balanced('()[]{}'), True, "()[]{}")
assert_eq(is_balanced('([{}])'), True, "([{}])")
assert_eq(is_balanced('(a[b]{c})'), True, "(a[b]{c})")
assert_eq(is_balanced('f(x[0], y[1])'), True, "f(x[0], y[1])")
# Unbalanced
assert_eq(is_balanced('('), False, "single open")
assert_eq(is_balanced(')'), False, "single close")
assert_eq(is_balanced('([)]'), False, "([)]")
assert_eq(is_balanced('(]'), False, "(?]")
assert_eq(is_balanced('{[}'), False, "{[}")
assert_eq(is_balanced('())'), False, "())")
# Non-bracket ignored
assert_eq(is_balanced('a'), True, "non-bracket only")
assert_eq(is_balanced('(a)'), True, "(a)")
assert_eq(is_balanced('abc(def[ghi]{jkl})mno'), True, "mixed")
# Ensure bool return
assert isinstance(is_balanced(''), bool, "return bool empty")
assert isinstance(is_balanced('('), bool, "return bool false")
assert isinstance(is_balanced('()'), bool, "return bool true")
# TypeError
for bad in [123, None, [1,2], {'a':1}]:
    try:
        is_balanced(bad)
        raise AssertionError(f"TypeError not raised for {bad}")
    except TypeError:
        pass
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError(f"Wrong exception for {bad}: {e}")

# Verify is_bracket unchanged (spot check)

assert is_bracket(')') == True
assert is_bracket('[') == True
assert is_bracket(']') == True
assert is_bracket('{') == True
assert is_bracket('}') == True
assert is_bracket('a') == False
assert is_bracket('') == False
assert is_bracket('ab') == False
assert is_bracket(1) == False
